1.text: Yesu amaze gutegeka abigishwa be cumi na babiri, avayo ajya kwigisha no kubwiriza abantu mu midugudu y'aho.

2.text: Ariko Yohana yumviye mu nzu y'imbohe ibyo Yesu akora, atuma abigishwa be ko bamubaza bati

3.text: “Mbese ni wowe wa wundi ukwiriye kuza, cyangwa dutegereze undi?”

4.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Nimugende mubwire Yohana ibyo mwumvise n'ibyo mubonye.

5.text: Impumyi zirahumuka, ibirema biragenda, ababembe barakira, ibipfamatwi birumva, abapfuye barazurwa, abakene barabwirwa ubutumwa bwiza.

7.text: Abo bakigenda, Yesu atangira kuvugana n'abantu ibya Yohana ati “Mwagiye mu butayu kureba iki? Urubingo ruhungabanywa n'umuyaga?

8.text: Ariko mwagiye kureba iki? Umuntu wambaye imyenda yorohereye? Erega abambara iyorohereye baba mu ngo z'abami!

9.text: Ariko mwajyanywe n'iki? Kureba umuhanuzi? Ni koko, kandi ndababwira yuko aruta umuhanuzi cyane.

10.text: Uwo ni we wandikiwe ngo‘Dore ndenda gutuma integuza yanjye mbere yawe,Izakubanziriza igutunganirize inzira.’

11.text: “Ndababwira ukuri, yuko mu babyawe n'abagore hatigeze kubaho umuntu uruta Yohana Umubatiza, ariko umuto mu bwami bwo mu ijuru aramuruta.

12.text: Uhereye ku gihe cya Yohana Umubatiza ukageza none, ubwami bwo mu ijuru buratwaranirwa, intwarane zibugishamo imbaraga.

13.text: Kuko abahanuzi bose n'amategeko byahanuye kugeza igihe cya Yohana,

14.text: kandi niba mushaka kubyemera, ni we Eliya wahanuwe ko azaza.

16.text: “Ariko ab'iki gihe ndabagereranya n'iki? Bameze nk'abana bato bicaye mu maguriro bahamagara bagenzi babo bati

18.text: Kuko Yohana yaje atarya atanywa, bagira bati ‘Afite dayimoni.’

19.text: Umwana w'umuntu aje arya anywa, bagira bati ‘Dore iki kirura cy'umunywi w'inzoga, incuti y'abakoresha b'ikoro n'abanyabyaha.’ Ariko ubwenge bwerekanwa n'imirimo yabwo.”

20.text: Maze atangiriraho gucyaha imidugudu, iyo yakoreyemo ibitangaza byinshi, kuko batihannye.

21.text: Ati “Korazini, uzabona ishyano! Betsayida, uzabona ishyano! Kuko ibitangaza byakorewe muri mwe, iyaba byarakorewe muri Tiro n'i Sidoni baba barihannye kera, bakambara ibigunira, bakisīga ivu.

22.text: Ariko ndababwira yuko ku munsi w'amateka, i Tiro n'i Sidoni hazahanwa igihano cyakwihanganirwa kuruta icyanyu.

23.text: Nawe Kaperinawumu, ushyizwe hejuru ndetse ugeze ku ijuru. Ariko uzamanuka ikuzimu, kuko ibitangaza byakorewe muri wowe iyaba byarakorewe muri Sodomu, iba ikiriho na none.

24.text: Ariko ndababwira yuko ku munsi w'amateka, igihugu cy'i Sodomu kizahanwa igihano cyakwihanganirwa kuruta icyanyu.”

25.text: Muri iyo minsi Yesu aravuga ati “Ndagushima Data, Mwami w'ijuru n'isi, kuko wahishe ibyo abanyabwenge n'abahanga, ukabimenyesha abana bato.

26.text: Ni koko Data, kuko ari ko wabishatse.

27.text: “Byose nabihawe na Data, kandi nta wuzi Umwana w'Imana keretse Se, kandi nta wuzi Se keretse Umwana w'Imana, n'umuntu wese uwo Mwana ashatse kuyimenyesha.

29.text: Mwemere kuba abagaragu banjye munyigireho, kuko ndi umugwaneza kandi noroheje mu mutima, namwe muzabona uburuhukiro mu mitima yanyu,

30.text: kuko kunkorera kutaruhije, n'umutwaro wanjye utaremereye.”
